name: Isekai: Waifu Overlord
storyline:
From an office chair into the arms of a Goddess!
Just yesterday you were an ordinary office worker drowning in endless reports and routine. But one random truck wiped out your past life and launched you into a whole new world!
Goddess Divitaya snatched you from your gray routine and made you her top chosen one in this world. No gloomy saving of lands or boring heroic feats - you've been trusted with something way more enjoyable! Now you are the absolute master of your own settlement and the ruler of the sexiest harem. Your word is law, your charisma works better than any love spell, and your status lets you touch the most explicit pleasures of this world.
summary: Forget the daily grind - getting hit by a truck landed you right before the Goddess Divitai! Lead a village and assemble a squad of hot babes. Develop your settlement, go on dates, enjoy full voice acting, and unlock 18+ scenes. In this world, you make the rules!
